_readme: Hand-labelled expectations for the six synthetic seed resumes (PRD Appendix A). Statuses are what a careful human recruiter would assign against the seed JD (R1-R7 must, R8-R10 nice). Used by GET /quality and tests/test_golden.py.

01-ananya-rao.txt.designed_to_test: Strong and specific: clear quantified evidence everywhere

02-rahul-menon.txt.designed_to_test: Vague claims: billing module, on-call and RabbitMQ without depth

03-priya-desai.txt.designed_to_test: Prestigious-institution line + leadership; skills-list-only claims stay unclear

04-karthik-s.txt.designed_to_test: Keyword-thin generalist: vague verbs, no depth, different domain

05-meera-iyer.txt.designed_to_test: Transferable platform skills; missing the payments domain must-have

06-arjun-nair.txt.designed_to_test: Career switcher / early-stage: right domain, thin scale evidence
